status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY MODEL SCORE; no [[R#]] slot filled

gene_axis.rule: intersection of ARC gene_names / scGPT vocab / Geneformer V1 tokens

targets.rule: the 44 VCC 2025 validation CRISPRi targets, all present in the fixed gene axis

metrics.MAE: raw mean absolute error, ALWAYS reported separately; not comparable across methods with different delta scales
metrics.MAE_z: MAE after PER-PERTURBATION z-scoring of both matrices; adapter deltas are NOT on a log2FC scale

baselines.train_mean: mandatory, mean effect across training perturbations
baselines.additive: NOT APPLICABLE - no combinatorial perturbations exist in the VCC DE tables (W4); missing singles are never imputed

hard_rule: no model score without its mandatory baselines

T1.H1_status: DEMOTED TO EXPLORATORY by the preregistered rule ('If fewer than 5 independent atlases are available, H1 is demoted to exploratory')
T1.tau_status: UNAVAILABLE - W3 produced a CPU feasibility prototype only; the preregistered scVI/scANVI shared latent time axis tau has NOT been fitted, so the registered H1 macro-F1 label-transfer test cannot be executed and must not be imputed

T2.ground_truth: SURROGATE IN-SILICO PERTURBATION, NOT EXPERIMENTAL PERTURBATION: target-gene masking propagated along a co-expression matrix, on log1p(CP10K) expression
T2.implementation: row-wise correlation, algebraically identical to make_surrogate_effects (self-tested); avoids the 17,555^2 matrix
T2.cells: all QC-passing cells of each atlas; raw counts retained for models

T3.ground_truth: real H1 hESC CRISPRi log2_fold_change from the CC0 VCC 2025 validation DE parquet
T3.model_input: non-targeting CONTROL cells from the repaired 6.9 GB validation h5ad (generic cell-line context, as preregistered)
T3.alignment: DE tables pivoted onto the fixed 17,555-gene axis; absent (target, feature) rows filled 0.0 with density reported

scale_warning: Neither adapter delta is on a log2FC scale and the two are not on a common scale with each other or with the CRISPRi ground truth. DES/PDS/MAE_z are scale-free; raw MAE is reported separately but is NOT comparable across methods with different delta scales.
external_metrics: cell-eval 0.8.2 official metrics are NOT computed here; framework-internal DES/PDS/MAE/MAE_z must never be compared numerically with VCC leaderboard values
